name: Tribunal
source:
I’m your uncle, Mortimer. Your parents asked me to look after you while they’re gone… but you know that something’s off. That man isn’t honest...

[From [url=https://trickntreatgames.itch.io/tribunal]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“我是你的莫蒂默叔叔。你父母出门期间托我来照顾你……”但你心里清楚，事情绝不对劲。那个男人根本没说实话……
